settings.linked_accounts.link.password.description: Label of the password field in the dialog that links an account.

settings.linked_accounts.link.password.r.defaultMessage: パスワードを入力してください。

settings.linked_accounts.link.cancel.description: Button that closes the dialog that links an account.

settings.linked_accounts.link.failed.defaultMessage: 連携を始められませんでした：{reason}

settings.linked_accounts.linked.defaultMessage: {provider} のアカウントを連携しました。

settings.linked_accounts.failed.already_.defaultMessage: そのサービスのアカウントはすでに連携しています。

settings.linked_accounts.failed.unavaila.defaultMessage: そのサービスは使えません。

settings.linked_accounts.failed.expired.defaultMessage: 連携に時間がかかりすぎました。もう一度やり直してください。
settings.linked_accounts.failed.expired.description: Alert when the link expired before the service sent the user back.

settings.linked_accounts.failed.rate_lim.description: Alert when the user tried too many times.

settings.linked_accounts.failed.failed.description: Alert when the user cancelled at the service, or the service answered an error.

settings.external_confirmation.descripti.defaultMessage: 連携したアカウントでもう一度ログインして、本人であることを確認します。
settings.external_confirmation.descripti.description: Text above the buttons that confirm an operation (such as deleting the account) by signing in again at a linked service, for a user without a password and passkeys.

settings.external_confirmation.start.description: Button that leaves for a linked service to confirm an operation. {provider} is the service's name as the administrators wrote it.

settings.external_confirmation.confirmed.defaultMessage: {provider} でもう一度ログインしました。10 分以内に完了してください。
settings.external_confirmation.confirmed.description: Note once the user confirmed an operation at a linked service and came back. {provider} is the service's name.

settings.external_confirmation.start_fai.defaultMessage: 確認を始められませんでした：{reason}
settings.external_confirmation.start_fai.description: Alert when starting a confirmation with a linked service failed. {reason} is the server's or the network's reason.

settings.external_confirmation.failed.mi.defaultMessage: 連携していないアカウントでログインしました。連携したアカウントでやり直してください。
settings.external_confirmation.failed.mi.description: Alert when the user confirmed at the service with another account than the linked one.

settings.external_confirmation.failed.ex.defaultMessage: 確認に時間がかかりすぎたか、すでに使われています。もう一度やり直してください。
settings.external_confirmation.failed.ex.description: Alert when the confirmation with a linked service expired (10 minutes) or was used.

settings.external_confirmation.failed.ra.defaultMessage: 試行が多すぎます。しばらくしてからやり直してください。
settings.external_confirmation.failed.ra.description: Alert when the user failed to confirm too many times.

settings.external_confirmation.failed.un.defaultMessage: そのサービスは使えません。
settings.external_confirmation.failed.un.description: Alert when the linked service is turned off.

settings.external_confirmation.failed.de.defaultMessage: そのサービスは、ログインしたアカウントを受け付けていません。
settings.external_confirmation.failed.de.description: Alert when the account at the service does not meet the administrators' conditions.

settings.external_confirmation.failed.fa.defaultMessage: サービスでのログインを確認できませんでした。もう一度やり直してください。
settings.external_confirmation.failed.fa.description: Alert when the user cancelled at the service, the service answered an error, or it did not ask the user to sign in again.

settings.account.delete.confirm.descript.defaultMessage: アカウントはすぐに削除され、ログアウトします。元に戻すことはできません。
settings.account.delete.confirm.descript.description: Description of the dialog that deletes the account of a user who confirmed by signing in again at a linked service.

settings.invites.title.description: Title of the settings page of the invites that the user created, and its item in the settings menu.

settings.invites.description.defaultMessage: 知り合いをこのサーバーに招待できます。招待ごとのリンクで、決まった人数が一定の期間だけ登録できます。サーバーが登録を承認制にしているときも、招待した人は承認を待たずに使い始められます。
settings.invites.description.description: Explanation at the top of the user's invites page.

settings.invites.new.title.description: Heading of the region of the form of a new invite on the user's invites page.

settings.invites.not_allowed.defaultMessage: いまは招待を作成できません。使える招待のリンクのコピーと失効はできます。
settings.invites.not_allowed.description: Shown instead of the form of a new invite when the user may not create invites: the server or their roles do not let them, their account is restricted, or the server takes no new accounts.

settings.invites.usage.defaultMessage: 使える招待：{max, number} 件中 {usable, number} 件
settings.invites.usage.description: How many usable invites the user holds, and how many the server lets one person hold at once.

settings.invites.full.defaultMessage: 同時に持てる数の招待を持っています。新しく作成するには、どれかを失効させるか、期限切れか使い切りになるのを待ってください。
settings.invites.full.description: Shown above the form of a new invite when the user already holds as many usable invites as the server allows.

settings.invites.max_uses.description: Label of the choice of how many people may sign up with a new invite.

settings.invites.max_uses.description.defaultMessage: この招待で登録できる人数です（{max, number} 人まで）。
settings.invites.max_uses.description.description: Help of the number of sign-ups of a new invite. {max} is the most the server allows.

settings.invites.uses.description: An option of the number of sign-ups of a new invite.

settings.invites.expires_in.description: Label of the choice of how long a new invite works.

settings.invites.expires_in.description.defaultMessage: この期間が過ぎると招待は使えなくなります（最長 {max}）。
settings.invites.expires_in.description.description: Help of how long a new invite works. {max} is the longest time the server allows, formatted like the options (for example "30 days").

settings.invites.duration.minutes.description: An option of how long an invite works, in minutes.

settings.invites.duration.hours.description: An option of how long an invite works, in hours.

settings.invites.duration.days.description: An option of how long an invite works, in days.

settings.invites.create.description: Button that creates a new invite on the user's invites page.

settings.invites.create_failed.defaultMessage: 招待を作成できませんでした：{reason}
settings.invites.create_failed.description: Error when creating an invite failed. {reason} is the server's reason.

settings.invites.created.defaultMessage: 招待 {code} を作成しました。

settings.invites.link.defaultMessage: 招待する人に次のリンクを送ってください：
settings.invites.link.description: Text before the sign-up link of a new invite.

settings.invites.list.title.description: Heading of the list of the user's invites.

settings.invites.empty.defaultMessage: 招待はまだありません
settings.invites.empty.description: Heading of the empty list of the user's invites.

settings.invites.empty.description.defaultMessage: 作成した招待が、使われた人数とともにここに並びます。

settings.invites.state.description: Term of an invite in the user's list: what it allows now.

settings.invites.state.usable.description: State of an invite that people may sign up with.

settings.invites.state.revoked.description: State of an invite that was revoked.

settings.invites.state.expired.description: State of an invite whose time ran out.

settings.invites.state.exhausted.description: State of an invite that as many people signed up with as it allows.

settings.invites.state.creator_ineligibl.defaultMessage: 招待できない間は使えない
settings.invites.state.creator_ineligibl.description: State of the user's invite while the user may not create invites (their permission ended, or their account is restricted). It works again when they may.

settings.invites.used.description: Term of an invite in the user's list: how many people signed up with it.

settings.invites.used.value.description: How many people signed up with an invite, and how many it allows.

settings.invites.expires_at.description: Term of an invite in the user's list: when it stops working.

settings.invites.created_at.description: Term of an invite in the user's list: when it was created.

settings.invites.copy.description: Button that copies the sign-up link of an invite.

settings.invites.copy_invite.defaultMessage: 招待 {code} のリンクをコピー
settings.invites.copy_invite.description: Accessible name of the copy button of an invite. {code} is its code.

settings.invites.copied.defaultMessage: 招待 {code} のリンクをコピーしました。
settings.invites.copied.description: Toast after an invite's link was copied. {code} is its code.

settings.invites.copy_failed.defaultMessage: リンクをコピーできませんでした。リンクを選択してコピーしてください。
settings.invites.copy_failed.description: Toast when copying an invite's link failed.

settings.invites.revoke.description: Button that revokes an invite at once.

settings.invites.revoke_invite.description: Accessible name of the revoke button of an invite. {code} is its code; {date} when it was created, formatted.

settings.invites.revoked.defaultMessage: 招待 {code} を失効させました。この招待で登録した人のアカウントはそのままです。
settings.invites.revoked.description: Status after the user revoked an invite. {code} is its code.

settings.invites.revoke_failed.defaultMessage: 招待を失効させられませんでした：{reason}
settings.invites.revoke_failed.description: Toast when revoking an invite failed. {reason} is the server's reason.

settings.notifications.title.description: Title of the settings page of notifications (which notifications arrive in the app, by push, by email, and with a sound), and its entry in the settings menu.

settings.notifications.table.description.defaultMessage: 通知の種類ごとに、受け取り方を選びます。アプリ内でオフにした種類の通知は作られないので、プッシュ・メール・音でも届きません（届いている通知は残ります）。チェックが入ったまま変えられない項目は、常にオンです。
settings.notifications.table.description.description: Help text above the tables of the notification settings: turning a kind off in the app stops it everywhere, and disabled checked boxes are always on.

settings.notifications.section.ordinary.description: Heading of the table of the notifications about what other users did (mentions, follows, boosts...).

settings.notifications.section.moderator.defaultMessage: モデレーター向けの通知
settings.notifications.section.moderator.description: Heading of the table of the notifications for moderators (reports, sign-ups, appeals...); shown only to users with those permissions.

settings.notifications.section.instance.defaultMessage: このサーバーからのお知らせ
settings.notifications.section.instance.description: Heading of the table of the server's notices to the user (moderation decisions, the closure of the server, the supporter plan).

settings.notifications.column.type.description: Header of the first column of the notification settings tables, which names the kind of notification of each row.

settings.notifications.channel.in_app.description: Column header of the notification settings tables: whether the notifications are created and shown in the app.

settings.notifications.channel.push.description: Column header of the notification settings tables: whether the notifications are pushed to this device (Web Push).

settings.notifications.channel.email.description: Column header of the notification settings tables: whether the notifications are sent by email.

settings.notifications.channel.sound.description: Column header of the notification settings tables: whether this device plays a sound when the notifications arrive while the app is open.

settings.notifications.cell.description: Accessible name of a checkbox of the notification settings tables. {type} is the row (a kind of notification), {channel} the column (In the app, Push, Email, Sound).

settings.notifications.group.mention.description: Row of the notification settings table: a post mentions the user.

settings.notifications.group.follow.description: Row of the notification settings table: someone followed the user.

settings.notifications.group.follow_requ.description: Row of the notification settings table: someone asked to follow the user.

settings.notifications.group.follow_acce.defaultMessage: 承認されたフォローリクエスト
settings.notifications.group.follow_acce.description: Row of the notification settings table: someone accepted the user's follow request.

settings.notifications.group.boost.description: Row of the notification settings table: someone boosted the user's post.

settings.notifications.group.favourite.description: Row of the notification settings table: someone favourited the user's post.

settings.notifications.group.reaction.description: Row of the notification settings table: someone reacted to the user's post with an emoji.

settings.notifications.group.quote.description: Row of the notification settings table: someone quoted the user's post.

settings.notifications.group.poll_closed.description: Row of the notification settings table: a poll the user made or voted in ended.

settings.notifications.group.account_mov.defaultMessage: フォロー中のアカウントの移転
settings.notifications.group.account_mov.description: Row of the notification settings table: an account the user followed moved to another account.

settings.notifications.group.voice.description: Row of the notification settings table: an account the user follows opened a voice chat room, or the user was invited to one.

settings.notifications.group.admin_repor.description: Row of the notification settings table: (moderators) an account was reported.

settings.notifications.group.admin_sign_.description: Row of the notification settings table: (moderators) a registration awaits approval.

settings.notifications.group.admin_appea.description: Row of the notification settings table: (moderators) a user appealed a moderation action.

settings.notifications.group.admin_webho.description: Row of the notification settings table: (administrators) the server disabled a webhook that kept failing.

settings.notifications.group.admin_custo.defaultMessage: カスタム絵文字の申請
settings.notifications.group.admin_custo.description: Row of the notification settings table: (administrators) a user requested a custom emoji.

settings.notifications.group.admin_accou.defaultMessage: 制限中のアカウントの移転
settings.notifications.group.admin_accou.description: Row of the notification settings table: (moderators) an account the moderators limit moved to another account.

settings.notifications.group.admin_servi.description: Row of the notification settings table: (administrators) the announced closing date of the server has passed.

settings.notifications.group.admin_error.description: Row of the notification settings table: (administrators) a new server error, or one that happened again.

settings.notifications.group.moderation.defaultMessage: モデレーターからのお知らせ
settings.notifications.group.moderation.description: Row of the notification settings table: notices and decisions of the moderators about the user's account, appeals, reports and custom emoji requests, and follows ended by a suspension.

settings.notifications.group.service_clo.description: Row of the notification settings table: the closure of the service was announced, rescheduled or withdrawn.

settings.notifications.group.supporter.description: Row of the notification settings table: a failed payment for the user's supporter plan, its end, and its retirement. Not shown in the mobile app.

settings.notifications.sound.title.description: Heading of the section of the notification settings about the sound this device plays for new notifications.

settings.notifications.sound.enable.defaultMessage: 新しい通知で音を鳴らす
settings.notifications.sound.enable.description: Label of the switch that turns the notification sound on for this device.

settings.notifications.sound.enable.desc.defaultMessage: この端末で、アプリを開いている間に鳴らします。鳴らす種類は、下の表の「音」の列で選びます。
settings.notifications.sound.enable.desc.description: Help text of the switch of the notification sound; the Sound column appears in the tables while it is on.

settings.notifications.sound.play.description: Button that plays the notification sound once, which also lets the browser play it later.

settings.notifications.sound.blocked.defaultMessage: ブラウザが音を再生しませんでした。ブラウザのサイトの設定で音の再生を許可してから、もう一度試してください。
settings.notifications.sound.blocked.description: Error shown when the browser refused to play the notification sound after the user pressed the button.
